name: __GAME_NAME__
tagline: Drop in. Eat smaller blobs. Cash out whenever you dare.
description: A perpetual arena: your entry becomes a bounty on your head. Eat smaller blobs to claim their bounty, grow, and leave whenever you like to bank it. Get eaten and you lose your bounty — but keep what you banked.
skillStatement: Spawn positions come from the shared seed; all movement is player-controlled and resolved identically on the server. Survival and eliminations are determined by positioning, timing and risk management, not chance.
